# Alpha Vantage

Alpha Vantage provides free APIs for real-time and historical financial data, including stock time series, technical indicators, and more.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/alpha-vantage/.

## Actions

- **ALUMINUM**: Fetch global aluminum prices.
- **Balance Sheet**: Return annual and quarterly balance sheets for a company.
- **Brent Crude Oil Prices**: Fetch brent crude oil prices.
- **COPPER**: Fetch global price of copper in monthly, quarterly, and annual intervals.
- **Corn**: Retrieve global price of corn in monthly, quarterly, and annual intervals.
- **COTTON**: Retrieve global cotton prices in monthly, quarterly, and annual intervals.
- **Earnings Calendar**: Return the earnings calendar for the next three months.
- **Earnings Call Transcript**: Retrieve the earnings call transcript for a given company and quarter.
- **FX Daily Time Series**: Fetch daily time series (open, high, low, close) for a currency pair.
- **FX Monthly Time Series**: Get monthly time series (open, high, low, close) for a currency pair.
- **Get All Commodities Price Index**: Retrieve the global price index of all commodities.
- **Global Coffee Price**: Retrieve the global coffee price series.
- **Global Sugar Price**: Retrieve the global sugar price series.
- **Income Statement**: Fetch annual and quarterly income statements.
- **IPO Calendar**: Retrieve the ipo calendar for the next three months.
- **Listing Status**: Fetch listing status of us stocks and etfs.
- **News Sentiment**: Fetch live and historical market news & sentiment.
- **Stock Splits**: Retrieve historical stock split events for a symbol.
- **Technical Indicator**: Fetch technical indicators for the specified equity or currency pair.
- **WHEAT**: Fetch global price of wheat.
